tools.title: Snapshot
tools.desc: Copies your heroes, gear, beasts, decorations and base skin so you can paste them into your armory report.
tools.keywords: import data armory export heroes gear

tools.title: Skill Dismantle
tools.desc: Bulk dismantle the skill items you no longer need, with a checklist before anything is scrapped.

tools.title: Treasure Guard Merge
tools.desc: Runs the merge loop and handles every treasure popup it rolls. Pick how many merges and your Treasure Guard policy, then watch it go.
tools.keywords: hunting guild treasure guard merge popup

tools.title: Alliance Defense Skipper
tools.desc: Skips Alliance Defense waves up to the wave you pick. Each skip spends the normal in-game skip cost, and you can stop after any wave.
tools.keywords: alliance defense fortress waves skip monster

tools.title: Class Talent Reset
tools.desc: Resets your Class Talent tree and retrains it to the same point using 5 minute speedups only. Copies a full backup first.
tools.keywords: profession combat elite mechanical master talent

tools.title: TC Squad Sync
tools.desc: Sets your alliance's Titan Canyon squads in game from the site signups. For R4 and leaders; asks for the Titan editor password.

tools.title: Troop Optimizer
tools.desc: Rebuild after a battle: merge everything, clear demoted units that can never merge again, wear your best training skin, add training buildings in spare spots and fill every queue. Also plans the layout that fits the most units or planes.
tools.keywords: base layout train merge planes army navy rebuild

tools.title: Map Collector
tools.desc: Claims every Titan Blessing treasure map your alliance spawns and reports to your dashboard. Needs a Map Collector password.
